notes.title: Patch update Ver. 0.10.2 Easy and Hard Stage , New Challenge Stage
notes.notes:
- Add New Challenge Stage 
   - Combined stages 1-8 for non-stop fighting. Can be opened after finishing stage 8 to unlock

- Add Difficulty mode easy, normal, hard
   Easy Mode:
   - Monster attack power reduced by 50%
   - Monster hp reduced by 50%
   But
   - Experience received reduced by 50%
   - Gold received reduced by 50%

   Hard Mode:
   - Monster attack power increased by 50%
   - Monster hp increased by 50%
   And
   - Experience received increased by 50%
   - Gold received increased by 50%
   - Drop rate increased by 25%

- Add Remove Ability Feature in game play
   - You can press the REMOVE button on the Ability selection screen in-game after level up. The REMOVE button will only appear when either Active or Passive Ability slots are full.

- Minor bugs fixed

notes.title: New Major Update Ver. 0.8.1 Companion
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

We've added a new major update, making the gameplay more accessible for players.
Here's what we added new feature and fixed:

- New Companion System: Added buffs and assists in combat
- New Stage: Dark Forest (Stage 7)
- New Stage: Ice Dungeon (Stage 8)
- New Boss: Evil Wolf
- New Boss: Ice Golem
- Added Heal Ability for Cleric Companion
- Cleric Healer +HP 10-20
- Added Buff Passive Abilities for Companions:
   - Novice: +All Stats 5-10
   - Swordsman: +Damage 5%-25%
   - Cleric: +Magnet 5%-55%
   - Archer: -Cooldown 2%-25%
   - Mage: +XP 5%-55%
   -Thief: +Gold 5%-55%
- Added Cooldown Ability UI
- Added UI Controller and Keyboard Layout
- Added Reset Upgrade Passive Ability
- Fixed escape key not working after ability popup
- Minor bugs fixed

Thank you for your support.

The Last Loop Studios Team.

notes.title: Legendary Heroes Survivors officially launches into Early Access
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Survivors![/b]

The moment you've been waiting for is finally here!

Legendary Heroes Survivors officially launches into Early Access on April 3rd at 06:30 UTC.

The game has officially started its journey, so we invite you to join us on this journey.

We look forward to receiving your feedback and ideas to further improve the game.

Thank you for your support.
The Last Loop Studios Team
